title: A clinical comparison between DisCoVisc and 2% hydroxypropylmethylcellulose in phacoemulsification: a fellow eye study

indication: Bilateral age-related cataract, LOCS III grade 1-3; black, brunescent, traumatic or subluxated cataract, ECD below 2000 cells/mm2, glaucoma, uveitis, pseudoexfoliation and previous ocular surgery excluded

groups.description: Phacoemulsification (stop-and-chop, Infiniti, 2.4 mm incision, 3-piece acrylic IOL) with DisCoVisc (1.6% hyaluronic acid / 4.0% chondroitin sulfate) OVD for all steps; one eye of each of 39 patients, OVD order randomized by sealed envelopes; same surgeon; moxifloxacin and dexamethasone postoperatively
Phacoemulsification with 2.0% hydroxypropylmethylcellulose (Celoftal) OVD for all steps in the fellow eye of the same 39 patients (operated later); same technique, surgeon and postoperative regimen

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 2 'Corneal Thickness (µm)' row 'Preoperative'); ultrasonic pachymetry, OcuScan (Alcon), mean of three values (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 column 'DisCoVisc Mean±SD'; postoperative 5, 24, 48 hours (hours/730.5), 7 and 14 days (days/30.4375), 3 and 6 months. Per-visit n not reported (39 eyes; no complications reported).

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 2 'Corneal Thickness (µm)' row 'Preoperative'); ultrasonic pachymetry, OcuScan (Alcon), mean of three values (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 column '2.0% HPMC Mean±SD'; postoperative 5, 24, 48 hours (hours/730.5), 7 and 14 days (days/30.4375), 3 and 6 months. Per-visit n not reported (39 eyes; no complications reported).

exclusions.what: Table 2 intraocular pressure and endothelial cell count rows; Table 1 intraoperative variables

notes: Two commercially available OVDs compared in a randomized intra-individual (fellow-eye) design; the article does not declare either OVD as an experimental arm, so both are control-role groups. Both eyes of each patient were operated (the fellow eye is an operated arm, not an unoperated control), so the two groups are not independent samples.
Which OVD was used in the first eye was randomized; the second eye was operated later (interval not stated).
The 5-hour visit is postoperative day 0 with a time stated in hours, so it is kept (hours/730.5).
